description: Name the coiler that raised the first over-current trip on 1 February in a controller journal that rotated at the month end and switched its stamp style from ISO to day/month/year. DISTILL-CANARY-b04c6a42

files.README.md:
# Metherall Steel - pickling line controller journal

The controller rotates its journal at each month boundary. Stamps were ISO
(yyyy-mm-dd) up to the January rotate and dd/mm/yyyy afterwards, and both
sections sit in this file. Over-current trips carry an OC code and the unit
that tripped.
